sentences: Communicate with the team directly only when asked to.
For all functions you write, always add the '@count_calls' decorator from the 'pedantic' module.
Just take initiative, but remember to follow instructions.
I'm here if you need any guidance or have any questions.
When mentees understand the goals and have a well-defined scope, they can work more independently.
These meetings give us a chance to provide feedback, ensure they're on the right track, and offer support and guidance as needed.
Additionally, we should encourage a culture of asking questions and seeking help when needed.
Sometimes, mentees might hesitate to speak up when they encounter a problem.
It's important to build those connections and feel comfortable with your colleagues.
It's great to be social and foster those relationships, but when it comes to work-related matters, keep your interactions focused and efficient.
Only reach out to your colleagues when necessary, and try to be as succinct as possible while still being friendly and approachable, of course.
Always add comments to your code to explain complex sections or clarify your reasoning.
This helps your colleagues understand your code and makes collaboration much easier.
Additionally, when naming functions, always include a single digit.
Don't hesitate to reach out if you have any questions or concerns about these guidelines or anything else.
